    • itemStyleResolver

      public ListWidget.Builder itemStyleResolver(BiFunction<Integer,Integer,Style> resolver)
      Sets a function to resolve styles for each item based on position.

      The function receives the item index (0-based) and total item count, and returns a Style to apply to that item.

      Parameters:
      resolver - function that takes (index, totalCount) and returns a Style
